notes: The candidate covers two adapter-selected object-class groups, each with one FOM-defined directed interaction published through the standard set-based declaration service. A separate requester queries the subject through HLArequestPublications. The reports must identify both object-class/interaction pairs and the total directed-publication object-class count of two. No DDM region behavior is included.

requirements.statement: The subject publishes one adapter-selected directed interaction for each of two distinct adapter-selected object classes through the standard set-based API.

The standard MIM emits one directed-publication report per published object class. Each report identifies the object class and its directed interaction class, while HLAnumberOfClasses equals the total of two object classes with directed publications.
